title: Document Extract Service State
description: Turns a document into text a model can read — and says how well it went. (Runtimes: node; IDs: document-extract)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

ocr.description: auto, off, or force — see above. true/false are read as auto/off

ocrBackend.description: OCR engine (paddleocr, tesseract, sceptre, …). Empty lets the library pick

ocrLanguage.description: "deu", "deu,eng", or ["deu","eng"]. Empty uses the library's default

tables.description: Include extracted tables in the output

maxChars.description: Cap the text handed on; 0 = no cap. Sets truncated when it bites

minCharsPerPage.description: Below this, a page counts as having no text

minTextCoverage.description: Below this fraction of pages carrying text, the document is sparse
